Redefining Body Contouring
The ARTIQA Treatment
ARTIQA is ISAAC Luxe's non-invasive 3D body sculpting treatment — combining Thermal Shock (alternating hot and cold therapy) with Electro Muscle Stimulation (EMS) to reduce localised fat, tone muscle, and rejuvenate skin, all in a single session.

Thermal Shock

Alternating hot and cold temperatures "shock" fat cells, helping break down fat deposits while improving skin firmness by stimulating circulation and collagen production.

EMS (Electro Muscle Stimulation)

Low-frequency electrical impulses cause muscles to contract and relax, mimicking the effect of exercise to tone and strengthen targeted areas.

What It Treats
Fine Lines & Wrinkles — Face & Neck Loose Skin — Torso, Arms & Legs Localised Fat — Hips & Abdomen Cellulite — Glutes & Thighs

What to Expect
Your ARTIQA Journey

Recommended Sessions

Weeks Between Sessions

Downtime

Most patients experience mild warmth, cold sensations, and gentle muscle contractions — the treatment is comfortable and does not require anaesthesia. Some improvement in tone and texture, along with circumference reduction, may be seen after the first session, but visible fat reduction and firming typically appear after 3–4 sessions.

Before Your Session
✓
Stay well-hydrated in the lead-up to your session.
✕
Avoid heavy meals or caffeine just before the session.
After Your Session
✓
Drink water to support lymphatic drainage.
✕
Avoid strenuous exercise for a few hours.
✓
Follow any personalised aftercare instructions.

The Visionary Behind ISAAC Luxe
Dr. Geetika Mittal Gupta
Founder and Medical Director of ISAAC Luxe / Aesthetic Physician, and award-winning cosmetologist — Dr. Geetika Mittal Gupta is one of India's most sought-after skin experts.

With over 15 years of experience in aesthetics, Dr. Geetika has built a reputation for personalised care and delivering results with minimal risk. Her clientele includes celebrities, influencers, and discerning individuals who trust her expertise.

She is a pioneer in introducing globally advanced treatments to India — from AI-integrated diagnostics and cutting-edge IV therapy to advanced body sculpting technology — setting new benchmarks in luxury dermatology.

Qualifications

MBBS from Govt. Medical College, Patiala. Post-graduation in Aesthetic Medicine from Cardiff University, UK. Diploma in Aesthetic Medicine from the American Academy of Aesthetic Medicine.

Global Expertise

Attended numerous international workshops and conferences globally. Known for blending ancient and modern scientific techniques to deliver trusted, clinically tested treatments.

Celebrity Trusted

Preferred aesthetic destination for Bollywood celebrities, fashion icons, social media influencers, and high-profile personalities across India's entertainment and fashion industry.

Three-Tier Philosophy

Unique AI-driven approach to long-term beauty built on three pillars: Treatment, Prevention, and Maintenance — ensuring lasting results and healthier skin over time.
